title: Video as a material for editable text
blurb: Editable, wrapped HTML text and a playing video as two inputs to one shader. The video fills, pushes, plates and weights the glyphs. The same fill is built with CSS blending, an SVG clip path and a 2D canvas for comparison.
question: Can live DOM text be filled, lit or displaced by a playing video in a shader, and which of those can plain CSS already do with no canvas?
result: Yes. Fill and punch can also be done with mix-blend-mode or a 2D canvas. Displace, chrome, mosaic and weight need the pixels of both the text and the video, which only the canvas gives.
